benefits.name: Resy Credit
benefits.description: Up to $20 per month in statement credits at qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants.

benefits.name: Rideshare Credit
benefits.description: Up to $10 back per month in statement credits on U.S. rideshare purchases.

benefits.name: Delta Stays Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 back per year as a statement credit on prepaid hotel and vacation rental bookings through Delta Stays.

benefits.name: Companion Certificate
benefits.description: Annual round-trip companion certificate (Delta First, Comfort+, or Main Cabin) within the U.S. and to Mexico, the Caribbean, or Central America, issued on card renewal.
benefits.terms: Cardholder pays government-imposed taxes and fees of between $22 and $250.

benefits.name: Delta Sky Club Access
benefits.description: 15 visits per Medallion Year to Delta Sky Club, plus four one-time guest passes; unlimited visits after $75,000 in card purchases in a calendar year.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Four one-time guest passes per Medallion Year; additional guests $50 each once passes are used.

benefits.terms: Requires enrolled Delta flight for Centurion Lounge access; unlimited Sky Club visits after $75,000 annual card spend.

benefits.name: Centurion Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary access to The Centurion Lounge, Sidecar by The Centurion Lounge, and Escape Lounges when flying Delta.

benefits.name: MQD Headstart
benefits.description: Annual deposit of $2,500 Medallion Qualification Dollars toward Delta Medallion elite status.

benefits.name: MQD Boost
benefits.description: Earn $1 Medallion Qualification Dollar for every $10 spent on eligible card purchases toward Delta Medallion elite status.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry ($120) application fee every 4 years, or TSA PreCheck (up to $85) every 4.5 years.
benefits.terms: Global Entry credit every 4 years; TSA PreCheck (up to $85) every 4.5 years.

benefits.name: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First checked bag free on Delta flights worldwide for the cardholder and up to 8 companions on the same reservation; second bag free on domestic flights.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $500 per trip for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed 6+ hours.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $10,000 per trip and $20,000 per card per 12-month period for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 combined coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen baggage ($2,000 checked, $1,000 carry-on, with a $500 sub-limit for high-value items).

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Primary coverage outside the U.S., secondary coverage inside the U.S., for damage or theft up to $75,000, on rentals up to 30 days.
